ground_truth.main_content:
Explore Interior Design's 2025 Best of Year Award Winners

Interior Design's 20th annual Best of Year Awards continued its proud tradition of recognizing standout projects and products across the design industry, with winners revealed by Editor-in-Chief Cindy Allen during an unforgettable ceremony in Manhattan December 11.
